xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. These results have been prepared on the basis of Limited Review which are prepared in accordance with the Ind AS notified under the Companies (Indian Accounting Standard) Rules 2015. The result have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 12 2026.
2. Exceptional items comprises the write-back of Customer Advance of Rs. 2469 lakhs consequent to the settlement of sales contract worth Rs. 3785 lakhs.
3. Prior period tax includes self assessment tax paid for the Income Tax Return filed under section 158BB of the Income Tax Act. 1961.
4. The Company operates in one segment only ie Steel Pipes and therefore has only one reportable segment in accordance with IND AS 108 Operating Segment.
5. Previous period/years figures have been regrouped and reclassified to make them comparable with the figures of the current period.
